changeSet.author: rishabh

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='c_users' AND column_name='email' AND data_type='bytea'

changeSet.comment: Fix email and password columns from bytea to varchar using encode()
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE c_users ALTER COLUMN email TYPE varchar(255) USING encode(email, 'escape'); ALTER TABLE c_users ALTER COLUMN password TYPE varchar(512) USING encode(password, 'escape');
